$comment: EXP-1029 contract — THE styleguide section index, read by the web styleguide (sections/index.ts) and the IDE styleguide (apps/desktop/crates/ui/src/styleguide). Four ordered sections; every entry id names one placeholder file (entries/<id>.tsx, styleguide/entries/<id>.rs) pre-registered here so a leaf only fills its file and never edits this index. EXP-1019 moves the EXISTING entries into the four sections.

sections.title: 1 Style
sections.blurb: The values the controls are made of: colour, shape, type, motion and the icon registry.

sections.title: 2 General components
sections.blurb: The Exponential app's own controls. The generic set (buttons, fields, rows, pills, dialogs, meters) lives on ui.exponential.at/components and renders through the SDK.

sections.title: 3 Special components
sections.blurb: Compositions with one owner: a dialog, a tree, a settings surface.

sections.title: 4 Views
sections.blurb: Whole screens, photographed on every platform.
